author: IGN
description:
Take a look at gameplay and more from Neuron Activation in this trailer for the upcoming frantic rhythm-puzzle game filled with micro-challenges. Push buttons, flip switches, shoot targets and more in search of high scores to appease your overlords. Neuron Activation will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.

Music by Karl Casey @ White Bat Audio
title: Neuron Activation - Official Demo Launch Trailer

Players can now access the second warrior from Predator: Killer of Killers with the Jotun Predator, armed with a Shock Gauntlet that brings the might of the gods to the battlefield. The Jotun Predator is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

author: IGN
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Freefall '95, an arcade action bullet hell game developed by S-Bend Games. Players will embody a man stuck in a time loop as a flight crashes down from the heavens into certain doom. Progress through a winding narrative, pull off combos, and upgrade abilities as you fall from the sky endlessly. Freefall '95 is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Freefall '95 - Official Gameplay Trailer

description:
Watch the latest trailer for The Last Faith for the soulslike Metroidvania game to see gameplay and more from the Awakened Ancients DLC. The Awakened Ancients DLC for The Last Faith features New Game+, a Dungeon Mode, Boss Rush Mode, and Tower of Despair, along with new executions, gameplay improvements, new selectable characters, items and weapons. The Awakened Ancients DLC for The Last Faith is available now on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Xbox One, and PC.

#IGN #Gaming

Watch the Midnight Pre-Expansion Update Trailer for World of Warcraft, the legendary MMORPG game developed by Blizzard Entertainment. Players will be able to access a new update for the game ahead of the Midnight Expansion, fitted with new system updates and a questline. The Midnight Pre-Expansion Update launches on January 20 for macOS and PC, with the full Midnight Expansion kicking off on January 27.

#IGN #Gaming

author: IGN
description:
Microsoft is ready to showcase their upcoming suite of 2026 and beyond games. With looks at the highly anticipated entry into the Fable franchise, Game Freak's Beast of Incarnation, and Forza Horizon 6, the show is already shaping up to be a big one. At roughly an hour long, the Xbox Developer Direct is sure to be host to a slew of many more games as well. Recently, Xbox tweeted that 2026 is a big year for games with a "6" in the title. Could they just be referring to Forza Horizon 6 and the impending GTA 6 launch, or could the swirling rumors of a shadow drop for Elder Scrolls 6 have some Merritt? Either way, IGN will be right there in the action. Tune in on Thursday January 22nd, 2026 at 10am, then stick around after Microsoft's show ends for an in-depth analysis on everything show off with IGN's Unlocked crew.

#IGN #Gaming #Xbox
title: Xbox Developer Direct Livestream 2026 | Fable, Forza Horizon 6, Beast of Incarnation, & More!

author: IGN
description:
Check out the Announcement Release Date Trailer for Life is Strange: Reunion, a new installment in the cinematic narrative adventure franchise developed by Deck Nine Games. Players will witness a reunion 11 years in the making as Max is left with three days to get to the bottom of a devastating disaster at the University she teaches and an old friend, Chloe, who is in desperate need of help. Make use of Max's Rewind powers and alternate between both Chloe and Max's perspectives as the narrative unfolds. Witness the emotional finale of the Max and Chloe saga in Life is Strange: Reunion, launching on March 26 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Microsoft Store).

#IGN #Gaming
title: Life is Strange: Reunion - Official Announcement Release Date Trailer

author: IGN
description:
For Honor's new Hero is the fearless Juren, who fights with the Fang Tian Hua Ji, a polearm weapon. Joining the Wu Lin, Juren's relentless fighting style threatens to bring turmoil to Heathmoor. Learn more about Juren and the second update of Y9S4 during the Warrior’s Den on January 22 at  twitch.tv/forhonorgame at 12pm EST. 
Play For Honor for free for an entire week from January 29 – February 5 (February 9 on Ubisoft Connect) and if you like what you played, the game will be on sale for up to 90% off on select platforms.

#IGN #gaming
title: For Honor - Official Juren Hero Reveal Trailer

Take a look at the Collector's Edition Announcement Trailer for Marathon, an upcoming sci-fi first-person extraction shooter developed by Bungie. Players can check out the Marathon Collector's Edition, designed in partnership with PureArts, fitted with a 1/6-scale statue of the Thief Runner Shell. The Collector's Edition for Marathon is available to order now, with Marathon the game launching on March 5 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

author: IGN
description:
Watch Mark Hamill transform into The Flying Dutchman in this featurette from The SpongeBob Movie: Search For SquarePants, which is now available on digital platforms. The film will be available on Blu-ray and DVD on March 31, 2026.

SpongeBob and his Bikini Bottom friends set sail on their biggest adventure yet! When an attempt to prove he’s a true big guy accidentally summons the fearsome ghost pirate The Flying Dutchman, SpongeBob and Patrick are swept into a wild underworld quest. With colossal challenges ahead and a rescue crew on their trail, SpongeBob discovers that real courage shines brightest when friends face the unknown together.
title: The SpongeBob Movie: Search For SquarePants Exclusive Behind-the-Scenes Clip (2025)

Watch the Project: Doors announcement trailer for this upcoming action co-op game. Project: Doors throws your squad into a shifting maze packed with traps, anomalies, and creatures you’d rather not meet. 

Stick together, solve strange puzzles - and try to escape in one piece. Project: Doors will be available on PC.

#ProjectDoors #Action #IGN

author: IGN
description:
Meet the Majungasaurus family unit in this latest Jurassic World Evolution 3 trailer for the simulation game. The Majungasaurus is a carnivorous theropod hailing from the Late Cretaceous period. This apex predator is available free to all Jurassic World Evolution 3 park managers and features playful juveniles and both male and female adult variants. Jurassic World Evolution 3 is available now on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S. 

Build your own Jurassic World in Jurassic World Evolution 3. Nurture generations of dinosaurs with the series debut of juveniles, create and manage sprawling prehistoric parks around the globe, and let your imagination roar with powerful new creative options.

#JurassicWorldEvolution3 #ParkSimulator #IGN
title: Jurassic World Evolution 3 - Official Majungasaurus Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the Arena Royale Overview for Splitgate: Reloaded, the hit free-to-play first-person arena shooter developed by 1047 Games. 

Get the rundown from Design Director Josh Watson on the new mode coming to the game with Arena Reloaded, a redesigned battle royale mode that brings the fundamentals of arena gameplay to a more focused state. 

Arena Reloaded comes alongside a suite of new content with two new arena maps, a new endgame mastery camo, a limited-time event, and more with Update 2.2. Update 2.2 with Arena Reloaded launches on January 22 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
